data.summary: The pod startup took 98.0 seconds, significantly exceeding the 10.0-second SLO. This delay was primarily due to a prolonged image pull phase, which lasted 96.357 seconds. The image size of 648 MB, pulled at a throughput of 6.7 MB/s, was the main contributor to this extended duration.

findings.statement: The total pod startup time was 98.0 seconds, which breached the SLO threshold of 10.0 seconds.
The image pull phase accounted for 96.357 seconds of the total startup time, representing 98% of the duration.
The image being pulled, localhost:5001/demo-ai-service:fat, has a size of 647991705 bytes (approximately 648 MB).
The image was pulled at a throughput of 6724905 bytes per second (approximately 6.7 MB/s).

ruled_out.reason: The image pull throughput of 6.7 MB/s is consistent with the large image size and the observed pull duration, not indicating an exceptionally slow registry or network.
There were no model loading spans, and the 'model_s' signal was 0.0 seconds.
The application initialization ('app_init') took only 1.888 seconds, which is a small fraction of the total startup time.
